summary: The archive-path build blocker is preexisting: the same old harness requires an archive under modules/oniguruma on both source versions, while both Makefiles build bundled Oniguruma under vendor/oniguruma.

claims.necessity_reason: The review established linking jq_fuzz_execute as a required execution-compatibility obligation.

before.requirement: Link jq_fuzz_execute against the bundled Oniguruma archive produced by the before-source build.
before.reason: The before Makefile builds bundled Oniguruma under vendor/oniguruma; the fixed harness names modules/oniguruma/src/.libs/libonig.a.

after.requirement: Link jq_fuzz_execute against the bundled Oniguruma archive produced by the after-source build.
after.reason: The unchanged after Makefile still builds under vendor/oniguruma, and the fixed harness still names the modules/oniguruma archive.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The earlier fuzz-target link uses the same stale archive path.

claims.comparison_reason: The Makefile is an identical before/after pair, and timing uses the same fixed harness. The archive-path mismatch is therefore the same blocker on both sides.
